(2) Exact live callers and containerPorts verified across all pods, Services/targetPorts, ApisixUpstreams, ServiceMonitors/PodMonitors, Prometheus active targets (26/26 UP), ConfigMaps, Velero BSL/kopia jobs, CNPG Cluster, and Validating/MutatingWebhookConfigurations: narwhal-portal calls keycloak-service:8080, openbao:8200, prometheus:9090, alertmanager:9093, loki:3100, and tempo:3200 directly; Velero kopia maintenance Jobs carry only velero.io/repo-name; monitoring/loki uses monitoring/waypoint so ambient alloy-logs pushes via waypoint:15008 -> loki:15008; kube-apiserver (hostNetwork) calls storage/openbao-agent-injector:8080 and monitoring/prometheus-stack-kube-prom-operator:10250; Grafana Service :80 targets containerPort 3000; Prometheus scrapes config-reloader :8080 on prometheus/alertmanager and waypoint :15020. Hubble CLI/gRPC was unavailable on host so Hubble flow data was not used.

events.summary: Added gitops/resources/{iam,storage,monitoring}-ingress-policy.yaml and matching ArgoCD Applications under gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/ (sync-wave 2, ServerSideApply, prune+selfHeal, registered in docs/common/upgrade-waves.json). Each file pairs a pure podSelector:{} ingress:[] default-deny NetworkPolicy with per-workload allow NetworkPolicies so existing alloy-logs-ingress-policy, tempo-ingress-policy, and velero-metrics are never widened. Ambient namespaces (storage, monitoring) carry TCP 15008 (HBONE) on every port-limited rule (with baseline_default_deny updated in check-ambient-netpol.py and scripts/verify/ambient-netpol-check.sh); iam stays non-ambient. Host-network kube-apiserver webhook calls are allowed via pod-scoped CiliumNetworkPolicies (enableDefaultDeny: {ingress: false, egress: false}, fromEntities: [kube-apiserver, host, remote-node]) on exact containerPorts (8080 and 10250) for single-node and multi-node VXLAN portability. Removed monitoring-permissive from R244 KNOWN_ISSUES (updating ingress-isolation-probe.py tree test and R244-known label). Bootstrap scripts need no change because 09-istio-ambient.sh applies allow-ambient-kubelet-probes-ccnp.yaml before step 14 wave-2 GitOps sync and no install step deadlocks. Added R398 (check-kisa-ingress-default-deny.py --mutation-verify, 20 mutations) and updated docs and lessons-log.
